results.title: Population Aging and Its Impact on Human Wellbeing in China
results.content: # Population Aging and Its Impact on Human Wellbeing in China. The study findings reveal that an increase in population aging reports a significant and decreasing impact on human wellbeing. The main objective of this analysis is to estimate the impact of population aging on the human development index in China. The study investigates the impact of population aging on human wellbeing in China. However, none of the studies have analyzed the impact of population aging on human wellbeing in China. Results of the ARDL model states that population aging has a negative and significant impact on human wellbeing in the long run in all four models. Based on these estimates, we can state that population aging help to decrease human wellbeing both in the short and long run. Keywords: ARDL, population aging, human wellbeing, health expenditure, China. Citation: Wang M-Y, Sung H-C and Liu J-Y (2022) Population Aging and Its Impact on Human Wellbeing in China.
